match.reason: The bank point teaches why a business plan matters, not the help that accountants, advisers and professional bodies give owners, so no bank point teaches the new point's idea.

draft.title: Help from professionals
card: Accountant
helps an owner keep records, prepare reports and meet tax duties. An accountant can also explain what the figures say about how the business is going.
Business adviser
helps an owner plan. This can include setting goals, testing an idea, or choosing how to grow, so the owner makes fewer costly mistakes.
Professional body
is an organisation that members of a profession join. It sets standards for members' work and conduct, and it offers training and support.
Owners can use these people to plan ahead, keep good records and avoid mistakes that cost money. The owner still makes the final decisions.
draft.remember: Professionals help owners plan, keep records and avoid costly mistakes, but the owner decides.

a.q: Which role is best described as helping an owner set goals and test a business idea before it starts?
opts: A professional body setting member standards
a.why: A business adviser helps owners plan, such as setting goals and testing an idea. An accountant is the most tempting wrong option, but the card links accountants to records, reports and tax duties rather than planning an idea.
a.clue: Which role is described as helping an owner plan?

b.q: Lena opens a bakery in Geelong. She wants her books to be accurate and her tax duties met on time. Whose help fits this need best?
b.why: Keeping records and meeting tax duties are tasks the card gives to an accountant. A business adviser is tempting because advisers help with business, but their help is mainly with planning, such as goals and growth.
b.clue: Think about who helps with records and tax.

problems.detail: The right option, 'A business adviser', is the only bare option. Each distractor carries a phrase naming a different job ('setting member standards', 'providing a loan', 'preparing tax returns'), so a student can rule them out and pick the odd one out without knowing the idea.

check.summary: The card and answers are accurate. In question a, the right option stands out because it is the only one without a phrase describing a different job, so consider giving all options the same plain form.
